messages.content:
<role>
You check one property (signal) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is this a problem with Keelwater's product that a squad could act on? Pass means yes.
Fail if the cause is outside the product (pricing, contracts, the customer's own IT, staffing), if a help article would have answered it, or if it is praise.
A feature request or a described workaround is signal.
The evidence is the title, the problem statement and up to 12 customer quotes with route and date.
</definition>
<evidence>
{
 "problem_statement": "The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type.",
 "quotes": [
  {
   "date": "2026-09-23T09:05:00Z",
   "quote": "Documents: click \"Document type\", rage x5... Documents: click \"Open\"",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-19T11:36:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Also, the document upload system keeps assigning the wrong category — say, putting repair quotes under correspondence — which leads to incorrect file type issues.",
   "route": "account_management"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-27T09:02:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-11T12:56:00+00:00",
   "quote": "We’re still wrestling with the wrong document category issue — garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.",
   "route": "support"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-10T09:41:00+00:00",
   "quote": "Also, when we upload garage estimates, they land under Correspondence — that incorrect file type is causing handlers to manually re-categorise everything.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-09-14T15:35:00Z",
   "quote": "click \"Document type\", rage x5...click \"Save\"",
   "route": "sessions"
  },
  {
   "date": "2026-10-06T14:24:00+00:00",
   "quote": "when we upload garage estimates, they’re landing in the wrong document category—like under Correspondence—and we’re having to manually move them, which risks things slipping through the cracks.",
   "route": "onboarding"
  }
 ],
 "title": "The user gets frustrated when trying to select a document type."
}
</evidence>
<task>
Write a critique of 2-5 sentences naming the claim, quote or item you checked and what you found. Then give the verdict. If any single item fails, the verdict is fail.
</task>
<output>
JSON only: {"critique": string, "verdict": "pass" | "fail"}
</output>

response.content: {"critique": "The claim is that document type selection and automatic categorization are product problems. Multiple quotes across support, onboarding, and account_management consistently report garage estimates being auto-assigned to the wrong category (Correspondence), forcing handlers to manually re-categorize and risking missed evidence; session data shows rage-clicking on 'Document type' and 'Save'. The cause lies in Keelwater's document classification behavior, which a squad could address, and is not explained by pricing, contracts, customer IT, or a help article.", "verdict": "pass"}
